title: Chalo, hum chale!
format: Kitty Gang bazaar bargaining ritual on the Bazaar Bargain game: Shruti uses the classic walk-away trick at three stalls, each stall is a prize group, then she tries the same trick on the Housie game and wins the Clutch group

experiment.hook: Shruti with a flat stare and raised brow on the Bazaar Bargain home art, heartbeat at 0 s, mascot ball spinning above, chip 'MOL-BHAAV: SHRUTI LIVE!' pinned from the first frame, she says 'Bhaiya, sahi daam lagao!'
experiment.variable: the pattern viewers know by heart comes from real life, not TV: the bazaar walk-away bargain ('Chalo, hum chale!' then the shopkeeper calls you back) repeated three times with the shopkeeper caving faster each time, at the same short length as the TV-voice winners (about 15 s, 8 shots, 'SAUDA x/3' chips), to see if 'known by heart' works without a media voice
experiment.hypothesis: every woman 30 to 55 has done the walk-away trick, so the line feels like her own and the rule of three gives the middle a rhythm she can predict: skip under 50% (TV-voice reels 45.2 to 47.6), watched % above 24 (best 26), at least 1 share or tag from 'jo bazaar mein sabse zyada mol-bhaav karti hai'

idea: Shruti bargains at the bazaar with the walk-away trick: at the Choodi stall Aditi calls her back, at the Dupatta stall Aditi caves before she even turns, at the Jutti stall Aditi just begs her to take it; then on the Housie game Shruti tells the ball 'number do, warna hum chale' and wins the Clutch group.
beats: hook: bhaiya sahi daam lagao / sauda 1/3 choodi: chalo hum chale, aaiye didi / sauda 2/3 dupatta: Aditi caves before she turns / sauda 3/3 jutti: Aditi begs her to go / turn: Shruti tries the trick on the game / the call / reveal: Clutch group is Shruti's / button: Aditi, Housie bhi maan gayi
logline: Shruti wins every bazaar bargain by pretending to walk away, then pulls the same trick on the Bazaar Bargain Housie and wins the Clutch group.
game: the walk-away trick works faster every time, even on the Housie ball
caption: Mol-bhaav mein yeh trick kaun kaun lagata hai? Bazaar wali saheli ko tag karo! Aaj ki {theme} Housie mein milte hain.

lines.text: Ruko didi! Abhi mudi bhi nahi!
lines.say: रुको दीदी! अभी मुड़ी भी नहीं!
